messages.text: HEADS UP!!! just got out of the judging room and we are officially 3rd in the Dropbox track. 🎉🎉🎉
WHAT. actually? i was bracing for last place honestly. did they like the privacy bit?
they loved it. one judge specifically asked how we ensured the free-text data wasn't being sold or used for ad tracking. your "local processing + double opt-in" answer landed perfectly.
haha okay so chen's infra talk was a waste of everyone's time but at least the result is good. i owe me and noor an apology for not trusting the text more.
don't apologize, just take the win. also, the CS chair is already asking about it in her office. she heard from the judges. this is actually blowing up a bit.
whoa. the chair? that's... new. does this mean the pilot meeting on the 29th is now a formality?

definitely not a formality, but the mood has shifted from "interesting student project" to "what can we do with this." i'll send you a one-pager for the privacy summary by friday so we're ready. congrats team.
thank you diego. genuinely. going to go stare at the wall for five minutes to let it sink in.
